spec.assertion: Structural: buff stat hitRatePct, value 5.04, maxStacks 3, durationSec 5, target self, trigger hitCount{count:60}. Behavioural: (a) applications == floor(misato's normal-attack damage events / 60) ±1 — fails under an interval or shotFired trigger (shotFired asserted to produce >10x applications); (b) stacks ramp 1 -> 3 and never exceed 3 — fails under an uncapped or 1-stack read; (c) zeroing the buff strictly lowers misato's total (hitRatePct is core-hit-live) while every teammate stays byte-identical — fails under an allies-scoped read of 'Affects self'; (d) maxStacks:1 and durationSec:1 variants each strictly lower her total — fails if the cap or the window is not bound. ⚑ Only the SIGN of the Hit-Rate->core conversion is asserted, never a magnitude (hrCoreMult is a derived, measured-only quantity); no absolute application count is pinned because SMG cadence is datamine-unreliable.

Structural: a SECOND, independent counter — trigger hitCount{count:120} (fails if it reuses S1-a's 60), target alliesLowestHp{count:1} (fails under an 'all allies' read), effect heal. Behavioural: dropping the block leaves every unit's total byte-identical — the v1 leftmost-ally stand-in for 'lowest HP' resolves to the B1 slot, which has no on-recovery consumer. Non-vacuity guard: the SAME block retargeted to 'allies' reaches the B2 slot's on-recovery kit and yields strictly more buffApply traffic, proving the inertness is a property of the target set, not of a dead trigger. Heal magnitude (8.04% of caster final Max HP) is unassertable — the engine models no HP pool and heal effects carry no amount.

it.skip. No engine primitive: the scope-lock boss has no shield entity and there is no shield-damage StatKey, so the line has nothing to scale. Also note the activation clause is a self-status gate on S1-a's own buff, for which no `requiresSelfBuff` gate exists — the closest faithful encoding would piggyback S1-a's hitCount:60 trigger with the same 5s window, but with no payload stat that is moot. Belongs verbatim in `unmodeled.skill2`.

it.skip. Heal effects emit a recovery EVENT with no HP magnitude, so an outgoing-healing multiplier has no payload; additionally the 'at max stacks' condition needs a stack-threshold self-gate the schema does not expose (resourceGate is resource-pool-scoped, not buff-stack-scoped). Belongs verbatim in `unmodeled.skill2`.

Structural: trigger burstCast (fails under fullBurstEnter, which over-credits on rotations the OTHER Burst I completes), effect heal{ticks:5, intervalSec:1} (fails under a single instant heal), target allies. Behavioural: total buffApply traffic under the faithful model strictly exceeds both the ticks:1 variant and the target:self variant — both reduce how often the B2 slot's on-recovery kit is refreshed. Non-vacuity: a separate probe run appends a damage-inert defPct marker buff to the burst block and asserts the marker is emitted, proving misato's Burst I actually casts in a fixture that already contains another Burst I.

fixtures: controlComp('misato', true) for every run — liter B1 / crown B2 / misato / helm B3, boss Fire, focus misato, deterministic (no seed). The fixed B1+B2 are mandatory or no burst casts at all. Crucially, misato's entire kit outside Shooting Manual is heals, and the engine models no HP pool — so the ONLY channel that makes a heal observable is a teammate carrying a `recovery` trigger, which the control comp's B2 slot (crown) supplies. Every heal assertion is therefore a delta in total buffApply traffic between the control run and a minimally-patched counterfactual. helm=true is kept because dropping it removes the only Burst III and the chain would not complete. 10 runs total: control, hitRatePct value 0, maxStacks 1, durationSec 1, trigger shotFired, S1-b dropped, S1-b target allies, burst ticks 1, burst target self, burst inert-marker probe.
gaps: it.skip S2-a 'Damage dealt to Shield ▲150% continuously' — no shield entity on the scope-lock boss and no shield-damage StatKey; no payload to scale. Also has no self-status gate primitive ('while in Shooting Manual status').
it.skip S2-b 'Outgoing healing ▲30.05% continuously' — heal effects carry no HP magnitude, and there is no buff-stack-threshold self-gate for the 'at max stacks' condition.

UNASSERTABLE MAGNITUDES: both heal percentages (S1-b 8.04%, burst 5.06% of the caster's final Max HP) have no observable payload — the sim models no HP pool, so only heal REACH (which targets fire a recovery event) and heal CADENCE (tick count) are testable, never the amount.

FIXTURE RISK (flagged, not worked around): misato is Burst I and controlComp already seats a Burst I (liter), so her own burst cast is not guaranteed. The burst-heal behavioural test is guarded by a dedicated inert-marker probe run — if that probe is the only red assertion in the file, the fixture needs a comp without a competing Burst I, and the burst model itself is not implicated.

WEAK OBSERVABLE: S1-a's 5-second window is near-indistinguishable from a permanent read in this fixture — the 60-hit period (~3s of SMG fire plus a partial reload) is shorter than 5s, so uptime saturates at 3 stacks either way. The window is pinned structurally (durationSec === 5) plus a downward counterfactual (1s strictly reduces damage); an upward one (50s) would be vacuous.
